title: Snail Mail and Pretty Stationery Gifts
label: Snail Mail
intro: Handwritten letters are having a real comeback, and the stationery girls were right all along. A wax seal kit, a box of cream notecards, a fountain pen that writes like butter and pink washi tape turn into a gift that keeps giving every time she mails something. Old-fashioned, in the best way.

images.alt: Shoppable collage on cream of a wax seal kit, cream notecards and envelopes, a fountain pen, pink washi tape, a linen address book, a pink stationery set and a brass letter tray.
Hands pressing a wax seal onto a blank cream envelope at a farmhouse writing desk with pink washi tape, a fountain pen, dried wildflowers and a pink glitter tumbler.
